plugins.name: e-spec
plugins.description: Spec-enhanced SDLC plugin — 11 skills (requirement, design, implement, dryrun-design, dryrun-code, dryrun-blueprint, dryrun-context, dryrun-plan, research, spec, bootstrap) + 8 SDLC guardrail hooks (branch validator, security guard, ruff format, context tracker, etc.)

plugins.name: crosschat
plugins.description: A method for agents to talk to each other — 4 skills (init, register, send, monitor) + a SessionStart hook that registers this project on a NATS-backed message mesh and hands the live session its listener command. Any session can then message any registered project by id. Requires `pip install crosschat` and a reachable NATS server; degrades to an informational message when either is absent.

plugins.name: ai-engineering
plugins.description: Methods for engineering agent behaviour rather than agent code — 1 skill (auto-iterate), which runs a goal to convergence by iterating on a single document. The agent generates, checks the result against an immutable goal, rewrites its own instruction, and stops when the goal is met or a fail-safe expires. Ships a template folder that is copied rather than described.
